title: Ship an InterlockingRunner with resolveTrain when JOURNEY_MAP declares interlocking routes (Bun)

facts.note: Station Master composition root and the train runtime tree; the rule is a standing repository-state check, so it applies whichever file changed.
Repository-state observer parsing server.ts JOURNEY_MAP for any {interlockingId, path} route object value (vs a direct trainId string), regardless of when the route was added.

Detector finding from checks/interlocking_runner_exists.mjs (bun_interlocking_infrastructure family): route object present but no InterlockingRunner class in scanned files, or class lacks resolveTrain.

fires: JOURNEY_MAP in server.ts currently contains an {interlockingId, path} route object and no `class InterlockingRunner` exists under src/trains/** — including a pre-existing violation and a change touching only server.ts.
A JOURNEY_MAP route object exists and an InterlockingRunner class exists under src/trains/** but defines no resolveTrain method.
A change introduces a new interlocking route object into JOURNEY_MAP.

A route object is declared and the only InterlockingRunner lives in an excluded tree (_generated/, node_modules/, dist/, build/, .next/): excluded files never count as an eligible runner, so the rule still fires.
doesNotFire: A pure direct-train consumer: every JOURNEY_MAP value is a trainId string and no InterlockingRunner class exists.

Scan exclusion: files under _generated/, node_modules/, dist/, build/, .next/ are never scanned and never count as an eligible runner (this does not exempt a declared route lacking an eligible runner).
Non-Bun stacks (covered by the agnostic core obligation or other stack realizations).

given: A Bun consumer's server.ts JOURNEY_MAP declares at least one {interlockingId, path} interlocking route object
when: the consumer is changed or checked (any file, whenever the route was added)
then: Define a `class InterlockingRunner` under src/trains/** exposing a `resolveTrain(action, inputs, state)` entry point.
prefer: e.g. src/trains/interlocking.ts: `export class InterlockingRunner { constructor(private readonly interlockingYamlPath: string) {} resolveTrain(action: string, inputs: Record<string, unknown>, state?: unknown): InterlockingResolution { ... } }`.
resolveTrain evaluates guarded routes, resolves exactly one admissible train, then delegates to TrainRunner.
avoid: Route objects in JOURNEY_MAP with no InterlockingRunner class (no route-control layer at all).
A runner outside src/trains/** or only in generated/vendored trees (never scanned).
unless: Pure direct-train consumer: no route object in JOURNEY_MAP and no InterlockingRunner class.
why: An interlocking is executable only as a route-control component; resolveTrain evaluates guarded routes and picks one admissible train before delegation, so without it declared routes cannot run.
evidence: If any JOURNEY_MAP value in server.ts is an {interlockingId, path} route object, a `class InterlockingRunner` exists in a scanned src/trains/**/*.ts file and declares a `resolveTrain` method.
Detector checks/interlocking_runner_exists.mjs reports no finding for this rule.
verifier_detail: Zero-dependency JS detector (atdd.workspace.bun), member of the `bun_interlocking_infrastructure` FAMILY detector: checks/interlocking_runner_exists.mjs.

Detection is a regex-over-source scan of the `src/trains/**/*.ts` selector plus the `server.ts` JOURNEY_MAP; which files are inspected and how class/method are recognized is the per-stack detector's concern.

Flag when an interlocking route (JOURNEY_MAP route object) is declared but no `InterlockingRunner` class is shipped, or the class lacks a `resolveTrain` method. Evaluated on current repository state, not only on newly added routes.
JOURNEY_MAP values are either a direct trainId string (direct train) or an `{interlockingId, path}` route object (interlocking route).
Never scan generated/vendored trees: `_generated/`, `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `.next/`. A runner found only there does not satisfy the rule.
Do not flag a pure direct-train consumer (no route object in JOURNEY_MAP and no InterlockingRunner class).
Severity 4, disposition strict: a newly introduced interlocking route without InterlockingRunner + resolveTrain is not suppressible and fails CI.
audit: Bun-stack realization of the agnostic core obligation `coder.train.interlocking-runner-exists` (core afokapu/atdd#1251, Part of #1246); summary: an agnostic 'the InterlockingRunner runtime exists' obligation rendered for the Bun application.
Normative text cites core runtime spec afokapu/atdd#1251.
Original name: InterlockingRunner route-control layer exists with a resolveTrain entry point (Bun)

Terms: interlocking_runner = a `class InterlockingRunner` under src/trains/ exposing resolveTrain(...), the route-control component that selects one admissible train and delegates execution to TrainRunner; journey_map = the JOURNEY_MAP action->route mapping in server.ts, values a direct trainId string or an {interlockingId, path} route object.

sharedNodes.text: strict disposition: a finding is not suppressible and fails CI.
